about: Joash brings the Queen's son before Solomon, who rises, embraces him, and sees his own father David in the boy's face; he dresses him in royal robes, seats him on a throne, and presents him to the nobles of Israel, who bless the boy's mother and swear to serve him. The boy gives Solomon the ring his mother had kept and asks for a piece of the fringe of the garment of the Ark of the Law of God. Tämrin relays the Queen's request: anoint and crown her son, forbid any woman to reign, and send him home. Solomon answers that a son belongs to his father, citing the curse on Eve, and says he will make the boy king over Israel. The boy pleads for his mother and country, and Solomon cannot say yes.

sentences.l: And-when seeing-him king Solomon rose-up and-received-him, and-opened the-opening-of his-garment from-his-shoulder (?), and-embraced-him with-his-hands upon his-neck, and-kissed-him his-mouth and-ፍጽሞ (?) and-his-eyes, and-said-to-him: Behold my-father David, renewed in-his-youth, rose from the-dead;
sentences.i: When King Solomon saw him, he rose and went to meet him. He loosened the opening of his garment at the shoulder (?), embraced him with his hands upon his neck, and kissed his mouth, ፍጽሞ (?), and his eyes. And he said to him: "Behold, my father David, made new in his youth, has risen from the dead."
sentences.n: Series of 3ms perfects: ተንሥአ 'he rose' (the main verb after the ወሶበ clause, without ወ); ወተቀበሎ 'and he received/went to meet him' (ተቀበለ + -ኦ); ወፈትሐ 'and he opened'; ወሐቀፎ 'and he embraced him' (ሐቀፈ); ወሰዐሞ 'and he kissed him' (ሰዐመ); ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him'. ወሶበ ርእዮ 'and when [he was] seeing him': ርእዮ is the gerund (or ርእየ + -ኦ), as in ch. 35. The garment clause is unclear: መዝግሐ ልብሱ I take as 'the opening of his garment' (መዝግሕ, a noun I cannot identify; (?)) and እመትከፍቱ as a run-together እም + ትከፍቱ 'from his shoulder' (ትከፍ 'shoulder'; the spelling እመ- for እም- is odd; (?)). Another possibility is እም + መትከፍቱ (an m-noun of ከፈተ 'open', the doubled መ written once): 'from its opening' (?). እንግድዓ 'neck, nape'; 'his' hands/neck: I take the neck to be the boy's. The second thing kissed, ፍጽሞ, I cannot identify: ፍጽም is 'perfect, whole' and ፍጽሞ may be an adverb 'fully' or a body part; I leave it unrendered in i rather than invent a body part such as 'brow' from the series with አፉሁ 'his mouth' and አዕይንቲሁ 'his eyes' (?). አፉሁ is አፍ + -ሁ with the object ሰዐሞ taking the part kissed as a second accusative. Solomon's words: ናሁ 'behold'; አቡየ ዳዊት 'my father David'; ተሐዲሶ 'renewed' (gerund of ተሐደሰ, tä-stem 'make oneself new'); በውርዙቱ 'in his youth' (ውርዙት 'youth' + -ሁ); ተንሥአ እምነ ሙታን 'he rose from among the dead' (the phrase of the Resurrection, used here only as a figure of speech for the likeness).

sentences.i: Then he turned to those who stood around him and said to them: "You said to me, "He resembles you." But this is not my likeness (?); it is the likeness of my father David in the days of his youth, and he is far more handsome than I."
sentences.n: ወተመይጠ 'and he turned' (ተመይጠ, tä-stem of መይጠ). ኀበ እለ ዘነውዎ 'to those who ... him': እለ 'those who' (plural relative), and ዘነውዎ is the 3mp perfect ዘነዉ + -ኦ 'him' (the -ዎ, not -ኦ alone, shows a plural subject, agreeing with እለ) of a verb ዘነወ 'surround, stand about' that I cannot confirm (?); the ዘ- is a root letter, not the relative (that is እለ). ትቤሉኒ 'you said to me': the 2mp perfect ትቤሉ of ብህለ (perfect ይቤ, ትቤ, ትቤሉ; the imperfect ትብሉኒ is the form in unit 5) + -ኒ 'me'. Solomon quotes what they have been saying. ይመስል ኪያከ 'he resembles you' (መሰለ takes the accusative pronoun ኪያ-). ማኅፈድ is glossed 'tower (?)' in the published parts; as a tower the clause is hard (unless 'tower' is a figure for stature), so I take it to be a noun for the figure, build or bearing (?). ማኅፈደ ዳዊት አቡየ 'figure-of David my-father' (construct). አመ 'at the time of, in'; መዋዕለ ውርዙቱ 'days-of his-youth' (construct). ይሤኒ 'he is beautiful, handsome' (ሠነየ, 3ms imperfect) + እምኔየ 'than me' (እም- + -ኔየ).

sentences.i: Then he rose and went into his own dwelling and clothed him in a robe of gold brocade, with a belt of gold, a crown on his head and a ring on his fingers; he clothed him in garments of glory that dazzle the eyes, and set him on his throne, which was matched with him (?).
sentences.n: ወአልበሶ 'and he clothed him' (አልበሰ, A-stem of ለብሰ 'wear', takes two accusatives: him, and what he was clothed in; used twice). ሶቤሃ 'then, at once'. ማኅደሩ 'his dwelling' (ማኅደር + -ሁ). ዲባጋተ accusative of ዲባግ, 'brocade, fine garment' (uncertain, as in ch. 35); ዘወርቅ 'of gold' (ዘ- as a genitive link, 'of gold'). ቅናተ 'a belt, girdle' (ቅናት, as ቅናታተ in ch. 13-16). The suffix -ሁ in ርእሱ, አጽባዕቱ is 'his'; the crown, ring, and so on are the boy's. ሕልቀተ 'a ring' that Solomon puts on the boy's finger; it is not said to be the ring of unit 11, which the boy's mother had given him and which he now brings back. አልባሰ ክብር 'garments-of glory' (construct); ዘየሀይድ አዕይንተ 'which dazzles the eyes' (ሀየደ; as in ch. 30, where the Geʿez has 'plunder' and the free rendering is 'dazzle'; (?)); አዕይንተ is accusative plural of ዐይን 'eye'. ዲበ መንበሩ 'upon his throne' (መንበር 'seat, throne'); ዘይትዐረይ ምስሌሁ is ዘ- 'which' + ይትዐረይ, 3ms imperfect of ተዐረየ 'be equal, be matched': 'a throne that is matched with him' (?). The suffixes are ambiguous (መንበሩ is most naturally Solomon's, the subject's; ምስሌሁ would then be the boy), so I say only 'matched with him'. The unit ends with a ፤ and Solomon's speech follows.

(imperative plural). ዝንቱ ውሉድየ 'this my child (offspring)'; ፍሬ 'fruit'; ዘወፅአ እምከርሥየ 'that came out from my belly/womb' (ከርሥ 'belly'). ዘወሀበኒ 'who gave me' (ወሀበ + -ኒ). እግዚኣብሔር አምላከ እስራኤል 'God, God-of Israel' (apposition; አምላከ is the construct). እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had not reckoned' (እም- 'from, beyond' + ዘ + 1cs perfect of ተሐዘበ 'reckon, expect'): 'beyond expectation'.

sentences.n: ሠረቀ 'he rose' as the sun rises (the verb is used of dawn and of a star), so ብእሲ ብሩህ 'a man, bright' is a luminous figure. እምሥርወ እሴይ 'from the root of Jesse': Isaiah 11:1 and 11:10 ('a shoot from the stump of Jesse ... the root of Jesse'; Romans 15:12), a messianic phrase here used of the line of David (Jesse was David's father). ሥርው is the construct 'root of' (the plural ሥርው is also used as a singular). ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king' (ንጉሠ accusative as a predicate). ለዘመደ ዘመድነ 'for the kin-of our-kin': the doubled ዘመድ 'kin, race' means 'our kin and all their descendants' (?).

sentences.i: He comes from his seed; no one will ask who his father is or say, 'Where does he come from?' He is truly an Israelite of the seed of David; in the likeness and form of his appearance he is joined perfectly (?) to his father.
sentences.n: እምዘርኡ 'from his seed' (ዘርእ + -ሁ). ዘኢየሐትቱ አቡሁ is ዘ- 'who, of whom' + ኢ- + ይሐትቱ, 3mp imperfect of ሐተተ 'question, inquire': 'who they do not ask (about his) father'; the sense is that the likeness makes inquiry unnecessary. ወኢይብሉ 'and they do not say'. ምጽአቱ 'his coming' (ምጽአት + -ሁ). ዘበአማን 'truly, in truth' (adverbial). እስራኤላዊ 'Israelite' (the -ዊ ending makes an adjective of an ethnic noun). እምዘርአ ዳዊት 'from the seed-of David' (construct). The chain በአምሳለ መልክአ ራእዩ 'in the likeness-of form-of his-appearance' is three nouns each in the construct state before the last with its suffix. ተልሕኰ: I take it as the verb ተልሕከ 'be joined, cling' (the ኰ for ከ is odd, possibly a printing slip; (?)), and ፍጹመ 'perfectly' (accusative adverb). The unit ends with a ፤ and continues the nobles' speech.

sentences.n: ወወሰደ 'and he carried, he brought' (ወሰደ 'take away, bring'); ለአቡሁ ... ይእተ ሕልቀተ 'to his father that ring': ይእተ is the feminine 'that', agreeing with ሕልቀት 'ring' (accusative ሕልቀተ). እንተ ወሀበቶ እሙ 'which his mother gave him' (ወሀበት + -ኦ; እም + -ሁ). በባሕቲቶሙ 'in their being alone' (ባሕቲት 'aloneness' + -ሙ 'their'): 'the two of them alone, in private'. It is the ring that the Queen kept and passed to her son. ንሣእአ: the imperative of ነሥአ is ንሣእ 'take!'; the final -አ is stray (a recurring oddity in Bezold's printing in this chapter: ወሀበነአ, ወአንግሦአ, ወአዝዝአ, ወፈንዎአ, ወአንሰአ), probably a spelling habit for a long final vowel and not a morpheme. ዘንተነገረ is ዘንተ ነገረ 'this matter' printed as one word. ዘተናገርከ 'which you spoke' (ተናገረ 'converse, speak with') ምስለ ንግሥት 'with the Queen'.

sentences.i: and give us a piece of the fringe of the garment of the Ark of the Law of God, that we may bow to her all our days, we and all who are under us and all who are within the Queen's kingdom."
sentences.n: ወሀበነአ: ወ- + ሀበነ 'give us!' (imperative of ወሀበ + -ነ) with the stray -አ (see the note on ንሣእአ in the last unit). እምዘፈረ ልብሳ ለታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'from the fringe of her garment, of the Ark of the Law of God': እም- is partitive 'some of'; ዘፈር 'fringe, hem' is a guess from context, as in ch. 35 (?); the ልብሳ 'her garment' (ልብስ + -ሃ) anticipates its owner, named after it with ለ- (ለታቦተ 'of the Ark'; ታቦት is feminine, so 'her'). This is the Zion/Ark theology of the work: the Ark of the Law is Zion's sanctuary, and its garment is a relic that can be carried abroad. ከመ ንስግድ ላቲ 'that we may bow to her' (ሰገደ 'bow, worship'; ላቲ 'to her'). በኵሉ መዋዕሊነ 'in all our days'. ወኵሎሙ እለ እምታሕቴነ 'and all those who are under us' (እምታሕቴነ 'from beneath us', i.e. subject to us); ወእለ እምውስተ መንግሥተ ንግሥት 'and those who are within the Queen's kingdom'. The speaker is the boy; the plural ንስግድ includes his men.

sentences.i: And Tämrin the merchant said to him again: "Hear, O king, what your handmaid the Queen, my lady, sent me to say about this child: anoint him, consecrate him, bless him, and make him king over our country; decree that no woman shall reign forever; and send him in peace;
sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again'. ነጋዲ ተምሪን 'the merchant Tämrin' (the Queen's chief merchant; name as in ch. 22). ስማዕ ኦንጉሥ 'hear, O king' (the ኦ 'O' is written onto ንጉሥ). ዘለአከተኒ አመትከ ንግሥት እግዝእትየ is 'that which she sent me, your maidservant the Queen, my lady': ዘ- here is 'what', and ለአከት is 3fs, 'she sent me' (ለአከ + -ተ + -ኒ); አመት 'maidservant' + -ከ 'your' with ንግሥት in apposition, and እግዝእትየ 'my lady' (እግዝእት + -የ). The message follows: ለዝንቱ ሕፃን 'for this child' and then five imperatives with -ኦ 'him': ቅብኦ 'anoint him', ቀድሶ 'consecrate him', ባርኮ 'bless him', ወአንግሦአ 'and make-king him' (አንገሠ, the causative of ነግሠ 'reign') with stray -አ, ወአዝዝአ 'and command' (stray -አ, or perhaps with an omitted object; (?)), ወፈንዎአ 'and send him' (stray -አ). ለብሔርነ 'over our country'. ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign' (3fs jussive); ለዓለመ ዓለም 'for ever and ever'. The request ends the line of queens and gives the throne to a male line; the speaker is Tämrin, relaying the Queen's message.

sentences.n: The message passes into the Queen's first person. ወአንሰአ is ወ- + አንሰ 'and as for me' (አነ + emphatic -ሰ) with a stray -አ. ኢፈቀድኩ 'I did not wish' (1cs perfect of ፈቀደ) with ከመ ይምጻእ 'that he come' (3ms subjunctive of መጽአ); ዝየ 'here'. አላ 'but'. አጽሐበኒ: I do not know the verb (the published entry is 'wearied me, pressed on me', from context (?)); its subject is the boy, the same 'he' as ከመ ይምጻእ. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. ኀቤከ 'to you' (ኀበ + -ከ).

sentences.i: and I feared for him, lest he fall ill on the road, or from thirst for water, or from the heat of the sun, and lest he bring my gray hairs down to the grave in sorrow;
sentences.n: ፈራህኩ ሎቱ 'I feared for him' (1cs perfect; ሎቱ 'for him'). ከመ ... ኢ- 'lest' governs both ኢይድወይ 'he fall ill' and ኢያውርድ 'he bring down' (3ms subjunctives, after እመቦ 'if perhaps there is'). በጽምአ ማይ 'in thirst-of water' (construct); በሐሩረ ፀሐይ 'in heat-of the sun' (construct). ኢያውርድ ርሥኣንየ ውስተ መቃብር በሐዘን 'bring down my grey hairs into the grave in sorrow' echoes Jacob's words in Genesis 42:38 and 44:29, 31 ('you will bring down my grey hairs in sorrow to Sheol'): the Queen casts herself as the aged parent whose child is in danger. ርሥኣን is 'grey hair, old age' (the exact lexical form is not certain; (?)).

sentences.i: and I adjure you by Zion, the holy and heavenly one, the Ark of the Law of God, not to hold him back with your wisdom;
sentences.n: ተማሕፀንኩ በ- 'I swear/adjure by' (1cs perfect of ተማሕፀነ, the usual verb for entreating by something sacred). በጽዮን ቅድስት ሰማያዊት ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር: Zion is named with two adjectives (ቅድስት 'holy', ሰማያዊት 'heavenly') and then identified with the Ark: ታቦተ is the accusative of apposition 'the Ark-of-the-Law of-God' (ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'law of God', with the suffix anticipating the owner). This is the book's central Zion-Ark identification. ከመ ኢትክልኦ 'that you not hinder him' (ከልአ 'hold back, withhold' + -ኦ), በጥበብከ 'by your wisdom', meaning 'with your skill in persuading'.

sentences.i: for your nobles are unable to go into their houses or to look at their children, because of the abundance of wisdom and the food that you give them, as they wish (?), saying, 'The table of Solomon is better for us than that we rejoice and take our ease in our own houses.' And for this reason, in my fear, I adjure you: do not make him stay with you, but send him to me in peace, without sickness or illness, in love and in peace, so that my heart may rejoice at meeting you (?).
sentences.n: The Queen's argument: Solomon's own court is so bound to him that it neglects home. እስመ 'for'. ኢይክሉ 'they cannot' (3mp imperfect of ከሀለ) with the verbal nouns አቲወ 'going into' (አተወ) and ነጽሮ 'looking at' (ነጸረ), their objects ቤቶሙ 'their houses' and ውሉዶሙ 'their children'. እምብዝኀጥበብ is እም ብዝኀ ጥበብ 'from the abundance of wisdom' (ብዝኀ 'abundance' in construct) printed as one word. ወመባልዕት ዘትሁቦሙ መፍቅዶሙ 'and foods which you give them, their ...': I read መፍቅድ as 'their wish, desire' (from ፈቀደ 'wish'), 'as much as they want' (?). ይኄይሰነ 'it is better for us' (ይኄይስ + -ነ) with ማእደ ሰሎሞን 'the table-of Solomon' (construct), and እምንትፈሣሕ 'than that we rejoice' (እም + 1cp imperfect); ወንደለው I take as 'we take our ease' (from a verb ደለወ 'be at ease', cf. ተድላ 'delight' in ch. 35; (?)). በእንተዝ 'because of this'. አነ ፈሪህየ 'I, in my fear' (ፈሪህ 'fear' + -የ, as ፈሪሀ in ch. 27). ከመ ኢታቅሞ ኀቤከ 'that you not make him remain with you' (አቀመ, causative of ቆመ 'stand'). ዘእንበለ ደዌ ወሕማም 'without sickness and illness'. በሰላምከመ is በሰላም ከመ 'in peace, that' (run together). ረኪቦትከ 'your meeting/finding': the suffix is odd (the Queen means the boy's meeting him, or news of it); I read 'at meeting you' (?); if -ከ is a slip for -ሁ, 'at finding him'.

sentences.l: Answered the-king and-said-to-him: What to-her over a-son, to-the-woman, except what she-suffered (?) and-nursed (?)? And a-daughter to-the-mother and-a-son to-the-father;
sentences.i: The king answered and said to him: "What claim has a woman on a son, except what she suffered and the nursing she gave (?)? A daughter belongs to the mother and a son to the father;
sentences.n: Solomon's reply. ምንተ ባቲ is ምንት 'what' + ባቲ (በ + -ቲ 'there is to her'), 'what has she'; ባቲላዕለ is ባቲ ላዕለ printed together ('what has she over ...'). ለብእሲት restates the -ቲ of ባቲ ('to her, to the woman'); the other construction, ወልድ ለብእሲት 'a woman's son', gives the same sense. ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም ወተሐፅን 'except that which she suffered and nursed': ዘተሐምም is ዘ- 'what' + ተሐምም (a verb 'suffer, be afflicted', whose ending is not that of the 3fs perfect ተሐምመት; (?)); ተሐፅን 'she carried in her lap, nursed' (ሐፀነ; same form issue). ወለት 'a daughter' (the feminine of ወልድ) ለእም 'to the mother'; ወወልድ ለአብ 'and a son to the father': ለ- 'belongs to'. Nothing in the mother's claim reaches past the child's infancy: the argument that justifies keeping the boy.

sentences.l: And-God cursed-her, Eve, saying: Bear in-toil and-in-sorrow-of heart, and your-bearing, your-return to your-husband;
sentences.i: And God cursed Eve, saying: 'Bear children in toil and heartache; and in your bearing, your turning is to your husband;
sentences.n: The curse on Eve, Genesis 3:16 ('in pain you shall bring forth children; your desire shall be for your husband'; the Septuagint has 'your turning'). ወእግዚኣብሔር ረገማ ለሔዋን 'and God cursed her, Eve' (ረገመ + -ሃ, then ለሔዋን naming her; Hawwān is the Geʿez Eve). ለዲ is the regular feminine imperative 'bear!' of ወለደ (the initial ወ drops in the imperative, as in ሀበኒ 'give me!' from ወሀበ); በጻዕር ወበሐዘነ ልብ 'in toil and in sorrow-of heart' (construct). ወወሊደኪ ምግባኢኪ ኀበ ምትኪ 'and your bearing (ወሊድ + -ኪ), your return (ምግባእ) to your husband (ምት + -ኪ)': the verbless clause makes the return to the husband the thing bound up with childbearing. ምግባእ is the word of Genesis 3:16 'turning, desire'. Solomon uses it to say that a woman's turning is to her husband, hence her son is the father's.

sentences.i: under an oath bear children; and your oath (?) is your turning to your husband.'
sentences.n: The curse is repeated in a parallel form: በማሕላ 'in an oath, under a curse' (ማሕላ 'oath, imprecation'); ለዲ 'bear!' as in the last unit; ወምሒለኪ 'and your oath' (ምሕላ + -ኪ 'your'; the vowel pattern is odd, and ምሕላ elsewhere means 'prayer, supplication', which would also fit the parallel with በማሕላ; (?)); ምግባኢኪ ኀበ ምትኪ 'your return to your husband' (as before). The close ፤ ends Solomon's quotation of God's words.

sentences.i: As for this son of mine, I will not give him up to the Queen (?); I will make him king over Israel, for he is my firstborn, the first of my staff (?), whom God gave me."
sentences.n: ወዝንቱሰ ወልድየ 'and as for this one, my son' (ዝንቱ + emphatic -ሰ). ኢይሁባ ለንግሥት: ኢ- + ይሁብ (3ms imperfect of ወሀበ, initial ወ dropped) + -ኣ 'her'; ለንግሥት restates the -ኣ ('give her, the Queen'), and the thing given is the fronted ወልድየ. The prefix is 3ms, but the speaker is Solomon and the sense must be 'I will not give him' (cf. ኣነግሦ at once after); the same 3ms form stands for 'I' in ኢያፈቅር in unit 28 (the text does not use ኣ- for 'I' here), so I give 'I will not give him up to the Queen' (?). ኣነግሦ 'I will make him king' (1cs imperfect of አንገሠ + -ኦ; Bezold's ኣ- spelling); ላዕለ እስራኤል 'over Israel'. በኵርየ 'my firstborn' (በኵር + -የ); ቀዳሜ በትርየ 'first of my rod' (ቀዳሚ 'first' in construct; በትር 'staff, rod', here meaning sceptre or vigor): the phrase may echo Reuben in Genesis 49:3 ('the first of my strength'), but I render the words themselves, 'first of my staff (?)'. ዘወሀበኒ እግዚኣብሔር 'whom God gave me'. The ። ends the speech.

sentences.i: After that he sent him, evening and morning, good food and precious garments, gold and silver, and said to him: "For it is better to live here in our country, where the house of God is, where the Ark of the Law of God is, and where God dwells with us;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and after this' (እምዝ 'from this'). ይልእክ 'he sends' is the imperfect used of a repeated action in the past ('he would send'). ሰርከ ወነግሀ 'evening and morning' (accusative adverbs). ሠናየ መባልዕተ 'good foods' (adjective before its noun, accusative plural); ወአልባሰ ክቡረ 'and precious garments'; ወርቀ ወብሩረ 'gold and silver' (accusatives). The subject is Solomon, who sends gifts to win the boy over; the 'he' of ወይብሎ is Solomon. እስመ ይኄይስ ዝየ ንብረት 'for it is better, here, to live' (ንብረት 'dwelling'). ኀበ ሀለወ ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'where there is the house of God' (the Temple; ሀለወ 'is', with the subject as an accusative); ወኀበሀለወት ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'and where there is the Ark of the Law of God' (ኀበ ሀለወት printed as one word; ሀለወት is 3fs because ታቦት is feminine). ወኀበ የኀድር እግዚኣብሔር ምስሌነ 'and where God dwells with us' (የኀድር 'dwells', from ኀደረ). The Ark and the Temple are the claim of Jerusalem upon the son.

sentences.i: As for me, even if you gave me sweet foods I would not love them, and they would not please my body; what pleases me is the food I was trained to and grew up on (?);
sentences.n: ወአንሰዓ 'and as for me' (stray -ዓ on ወአንሰ). ለእመኒ ወሀብከኒ 'even if you gave me' (ለእመኒ 'even if'; ወሀብከኒ 2ms perfect + -ኒ). ጥዑመ መባልዕተ 'sweet foods'. ኢያፈቅር 'I do not love' by sense (the form is 3ms, 'he does not love', but the speaker is አንሰ; the same 3ms-for-'I' as ኢይሁባ in unit 24, whereas ch. 24 has the regular 1cs ኣፈቅር) (?); ኢይኤድሞ ለሥጋየ 'it does not please my flesh' (ይኤድም 'it pleases', አደመ; -ኦ and ለሥጋየ both name the one pleased). አላ ይኤድመኒ 'but it pleases me' (ይኤድም + -ኒ). በዘ ተመሀርኩ ወልህቁ መባልዕት: 'in what I was taught', ተመሀርኩ 1cs perfect passive of መሀረ 'teach' (ተመሀረ 'be taught, be accustomed'); ልህቁ is the 3mp perfect 'they grew up' (as in ch. 2-8), not 1cs ልህቅኩ, so there is no 'clipped form': its subject is the plural መባልዕት, 'and the foods grew up (with me)'. I give 'the food I was trained to and grew up on' as the sense (?).

sentences.i: and even if a land like the garden of Paradise pleased me, it would not please my heart; better for me are the mountains of my mother's land, where I was born;
sentences.n: ወእመኒ 'and even if'; አደመኒ 'it pleased me' (አደመ + -ኒ), the subject ብሔር 'a land'. በአምሳለ ገነት 'in the likeness of a garden' (ገነት is the garden of Eden in Genesis 2:8 in the Geʿez Bible, so 'Paradise'). ኢይኤድሞ ለልብየ 'it does not please my heart'. ይኄይሰኒ 'it is better for me' (ይኄይስ + -ኒ). አድባረ ምድራ ለእምየ 'the mountains of her land, of my mother' (the suffix -ሃ in ምድራ anticipates ለእምየ; አድባር is the plural of ደብር 'mountain'). ኀበ ተወለድኩ 'where I was born' (1cs).

sentences.i: And if I serve the Ark of the God of Israel where I am, she will honor me; I will look toward the house of God that you built, and I will make offerings and serve where I am;
sentences.n: ወታቦተ አምላከ እስራኤልሂ 'and the Ark of the God of Israel too' (the emphatic -ሂ on the last word of the phrase; አምላከ 'God-of' in the construct). ለእመ ገነይኩ ላቲ 'if I serve her' (ታቦት is feminine; ገነየ 'serve, worship'); በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am' (ሀለውኩ 1cs perfect used as a present). ታከብረኒ 'she will honor me' (3fs imperfect of አከበረ 'honor' + -ኒ). ወቤተ እግዚኣብሔር ዘሐነጽከ 'and the house of God which you built' (ሐነጸ 'build'; Solomon's Temple), ኣነጽር ላቲ 'I look toward her' (ነጸረ); ላቲ may be the house (ቤት is sometimes treated as feminine) or the Ark, which stands in it (?); ወእሠውዕ 'and I will sacrifice' (ሠዋዕ); ወእትጋነይ 'and I will serve' (ተጋነየ). Solomon's own prayer in 1 Kings 8:44 speaks of praying toward the house he built, which this resembles (?).

sentences.i: For long ago my lady the Queen rooted out (?) all those who served idols and who bowed down to another (god), to stones and to trees (?); she rooted them out (?) and brought them back to Zion, the Ark of the Law of God;
sentences.n: ቀዲሙኒ 'formerly, long since' (ቀዲሙ + -ኒ). ሠረወቶሙ 'she uprooted/removed them' (ሠረወ + -ቶሙ; the verb is related to ሥርው 'root', so 'root out, cut off', but I cannot check it; (?)), repeated in ወሠረወቶሙ; since the next verb is ወአግብአቶሙ 'and she brought them back', the sense is probably 'drew them out (of idolatry)', not 'destroyed'; ለኵሎሙ is the object repeated with ለ- 'all of them'. እለ ያመልኩ ጣዖታተ 'those who serve idols' (አመለከ 'worship'; ጣዖታት plural of ጣዖት 'idol', accusative); እለ ይሰግዱ ለባዕድ 'those who bow to another (god)' (ባዕድ 'other, strange'); ወለአእባን ወለአዕዋም 'and to stones and to trees' (a standing phrase for idolatry; cf. Jeremiah 2:27). ወአግብአቶሙ 'and she brought them back' (አግብአ 'make return, bring back').

sentences.i: for she heard from you, and was taught, and did as you said; and (she took) the Lord as her God (?).
sentences.n: እስመ ሰምዐት በኀቤከ 'for she heard from you' (ሰምዐት 3fs; በኀቤከ 'at your side, from you'); ወተምህረት 'and she was taught' (ተመሀረ + -ት); ወገብረት 'and she did'; በከመ ነገርከ 'as you said' (2ms perfect of ነገረ). The final words ወአምላክናሁ ለእግዚኣብሔር are a crux: አምላክ 'God' is clear, but ናሁ 'behold' (or a stray suffix) is not, and ለእግዚኣብሔር 'to/of God' leaves the construction open. My free rendering 'she took the Lord as her God' is a guess at the intended sense; the form may be corrupt, perhaps for ወአምለከቶ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'and she worshipped the Lord' (3fs perfect + -ኦ, the object restated with ለ-), which gives the same sense (?). The ። ends the speech.

sentences.n: ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'. ስእነ 'he was powerless, unable' (ሰአነ, 3ms perfect). ኦሆ 'yes'. አብሎቶ is the crux. It is not an infinitive (that would be ብሂሎ, as ርእዮ, ነጽሮ); the shape fits a 1cs imperfect እብል + -ሎ 'I say to him' (written አብሎ-, with the final -ቶ unexplained). Read so, the clause is a quoted thought, 'Yes, I say (it) to him, to his son', after ስእነ 'he was unable'. I keep the free rendering 'he could not say Yes to his son', the reading of the scene as Solomon holding out against the boy's return, but the opposite reading, that Solomon yields at last, is grammatically as good (?). Whatever the grammar, the sense is that Solomon holds out. ለወልዱ 'to his son'. The nine ፨ close the part.

glossary.ቤተ: ቤት — house of (noun, construct) · accusative 'a house' (አተወት ቤተ 'she settled in a house') · ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church' (lit. 'house of Christians')
glossary.ተሀበኒ: ተውህበ — it was given to me (3ms perfect passive of ወሀበ, spelled ተሀበ, + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ተልሕኰ: ተልሕከ — he clung, was joined (?) (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ልሕከ 'cling'; the ኰ for expected ከ is odd, perhaps a printing slip) (?)
glossary.ተሐዲሶ: ተሐደሰ — renewed, made new (gerund, 3ms, tä-stem of ሐደሰ 'be new')
glossary.ተመሀርኩ: ተመሀረ — I was taught, trained (1cs perfect, tä-stem of መሀረ 'teach')
glossary.ተማሕፀንኩ: ተማሕፀነ — I adjured, entreated (1cs perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ተምሪን: ተምሪን — Tamrin (proper name; spelling of the body of ch. 22, the heading has ታምሪን)
glossary.ተራከበ: ተራከበ — he met, encountered (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ረከበ 'find'; ተራከበ ምስለ 'met with')
glossary.ተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — he arose, rose up (3m sg perfect, n-s-ʾ)
glossary.ተወለድኩ: ተወልደ — I was born (1cs perfect, passive)
glossary.ተደመርከ: ተደመረ — you were joined, united (2ms perfect, tä-stem of ደመረ 'join')
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ታከብረኒ: አከበረ — she will honour me (3fs imperfect + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ትቤሉኒ: ብህለ — you said to me (2mp perfect ትቤሉ + -ኒ 'me'; the perfect of ብህለ is ይቤ, ትቤ, ትቤሉ)
glossary.ትኩን: ኮነ — that she be (3fs jussive) · that you be (2ms jussive, ከመ ትኩን ከማሁ 'that you be like him') · let it be (3fs jussive, ትኩን ሞትነ 'may our death be')
glossary.ትፈንወኒ: ፈነወ — may you send me (2ms jussive + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ትፈንዎ: ፈነወ — that she send him (3fs subjunctive ትፈንው + -ኦ '3ms him', joined as ዎ) · also 2ms 'that you send him' (ከመ ትፈንዎ ኀቤየ, the Queen to Solomon)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
glossary.ነገርከ: ነገር — your speech, word (noun + -ከ '2ms your') · also 2ms perfect of ነገረ 'you said' (በከመ ነገርከ 'as you said')
glossary.ነጋዲ: ነጋዲ — merchant, trader (noun; agent noun of ነገደ; plural ነጋድያን)
glossary.ንሣእአ: ነሥአ — take! (2ms imperative ንሣእ with a stray final -አ, a spelling habit of this chapter, not a morpheme)
glossary.ንስግድ: ሰገደ — we worship, let us worship (1cp subjunctive/imperfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ንብረት: ንብረት — dwelling, living (noun; verbal noun of ነበረ 'dwell')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አልብየ: አልቦ — I have not (negative existential አልቦ + -ya '1s')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of (preposition + construct: አመ ዕለተ 'on the day of'); when
glossary.አመትከ: አመት — your maidservant, handmaid (noun, fem. + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
glossary.አብሎቶ: ብህለ — I say to him (?) (a crux: the shape fits 1cs imperfect እብል + -ሎ, written አብሎ-, with the final -ቶ unexplained; not a verbal noun, which would be ብሂሎ) (?)
glossary.አቲወ: አተወ — going in, entering (verbal noun/gerund of አተወ 'enter') (?)
glossary.አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.አውሥእዎመኳንንቲሁ: አውሥአ — they answered him, his nobles (two words run together, a missing wordspace: አውሥእዎ 3mp perfect + -ዎ 'him', and መኰንን plural መኳንንት + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.አውሥኦ: አውሥአ — he answered him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him'; the person answered is the object)
glossary.አደመኒ: አደመ — it pleased me (3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.አድባረ: ደብር — mountains of (plural አድባር of ደብር 'mountain', construct)
glossary.አጽሐበኒ: አጽሐበ — he wearied me, pressed on me (3ms perfect, causative + -ኒ '1cs me'; root and sense from context) (?)
glossary.አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)
glossary.ኢተሐዘብኩ: ተሐዘበ — I had not reckoned, expected (ኢ- + 1cs perfect, tä-stem of ሐዘበ 'reckon')
glossary.ኢተኀጥአ: ኀጥአ — it has not failed, been lacking (?) (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, Gt; uncertain)
glossary.ኢታቅሞ: አቀመ — that you not make him stay (ኢ- + 2ms subjunctive, causative of ቆመ 'stand' + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ኢትንገሥ: ነግሠ — let her not reign (ኢ- + 3fs jussive; ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign')
glossary.ኢትክልኦ: ከልአ — that you not hold him back (ኢ- + 2ms subjunctive of ከልአ 'hinder' + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ኢያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — I do not love (?) (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect; the form is 3ms, 'I' is by sense, with አንሰ; ch. 24 has the regular 1cs ኣፈቅር) (?)
glossary.ኢይሁባ: ወሀበ — I will not give him (?) (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect ይሁብ + -ኣ '3fs her', the Queen, whom ለንግሥት restates; the thing given is the fronted ወልድየ; 3ms in form for 'I' by sense, as ኢያፈቅር in this part) (?)
glossary.ኢይኤድሞ: አደመ — it does not please him (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ኢይክሉ: ከሀለ — they cannot (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G 'be able')
glossary.ኢይድወይ: ደወየ — that he not fall ill (ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive, G 'be sick')
glossary.ኢፈቀድኩ: ፈቀደ — I did not wish (ኢ- + 1cs perfect)
glossary.ኣነግሦ: አንገሠ — I will make him king (1cs imperfect + -ኦ 'him'; spelled with ኣ-, as elsewhere in this part)
glossary.ኣነጽር: ነጸረ — I will look toward (1cs imperfect; spelled with ኣ-)
glossary.እመቦ: እመ — if there is (እመ + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.እመትከፍቱ: ትክፍ — from his shoulder (?) (run-together እም + ትከፍቱ: noun ትክፍ 'shoulder' + -ሁ 'his'; the spelling እመ- for እም- is odd) (?)
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ)
glossary.እም: እም — mother (noun; ከመ እም 'as a mother')
glossary.እምሥርወ: ሥርው — from the root of (እም- + noun, construct; Isaiah 11:10)
glossary.እምብሔርነ: ብሔር — from our country (እም- + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.እምብዝኀጥበብ: ብዝኅ — from the abundance of (wisdom) (run-together እም + ብዝኀ + ጥበብ, with ብዝኀ 'abundance' in construct before ጥበብ 'wisdom'; two words printed as one) (?)
glossary.እምታሕቴነ: ታሕተ — from beneath us, below us (እም- + preposition, stem ታሕቴ- + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
glossary.እምንትፈሣሕ: ተፈሥሐ — than that we rejoice (እም- 'than' + 1cp imperfect, tä-stem of ፈሥሐ 'rejoice')
glossary.እምከርሥየ: ከርሥ — from my belly, womb (እም- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected')
glossary.እምዘርአ: ዘርእ — from the seed of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምዘፈረ: ዘፈር — from the edge, fringe of (እም- + noun, construct); sense guessed from context (?)
glossary.እምየወኵሉ: እም — my mother and all (two words run together: እምየ 'my mother' + ወኵሉ 'and all'; a missing wordspace)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16) · እንዘ ይብል 'saying' introducing speech (ch. 36)
glossary.ኦንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — O king (ኦ vocative 'O' written onto the noun + ንጉሥ)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
glossary.ክቡረ: ክቡር — precious, honoured (adjective, accusative, qualifying አልባሰ)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀበቶ: ወሀበ — she gave him (3fs perfect ወሀበት + -ኦ 'him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወሀበነአ: ወሀበ — and give us! (ወ- + imperative ሀበነ with -ነ 'us' and a stray final -አ)
glossary.ወሀብከኒ: ወሀበ — you gave me (2ms perfect ወሀብከ + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ወለት: ወለት — daughter (noun, fem.; the feminine of ወልድ)
glossary.ወለአእባን: እብን — and to stones (ወ- + ለ- + plural አእባን of እብን 'stone')
glossary.ወለአዕዋም: አዕዋም — and to trees (?) (ወ- + ለ- + plural noun; the singular is not known, taken as 'trees' from the phrase 'stones and trees') (?)
glossary.ወለደቶ: ወለደ — she bore him (3fs perfect ወለደት + -ኦ 'him', joined as ቶ)
glossary.ወለጥበብከ: ጥበብ — and to your wisdom (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወለጽዮንሂ: ጽዮን — and to Zion also (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + emphatic -ሂ)
glossary.ወሊተኒ: ሊተ — and to me also (ወ- + ሊተ '1s to me' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወልህቁ: ልህቀ — and (they) grew up (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect, as ልህቁ in ch. 2-8; the subject is the plural መባልዕት; not the 1cs ልህቅኩ) (?)
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun; construct 'son of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደ ታራ ወልደ 'Terah begot a son'; ch. 13)
glossary.ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
glossary.ወሐቀፎ: ሐቀፈ — and he embraced him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወሕልቀተ: ሕልቀት — and a ring (ወ- + noun, fem., accusative)
glossary.ወመባልዕት: መብልዕ — and foods, provisions (ወ- + plural መባልዕት)
glossary.ወምሒለኪ: ምሕላ — and your oath (?) (ወ- + noun + -ኪ '2fs your'; the vowel pattern ምሒለ- is odd, and ምሕላ elsewhere means 'prayer, supplication', which would also fit) (?)
glossary.ወሠረወቶሙ: ሠረወ — and she uprooted them (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect + -ሙ; see ሠረወቶሙ) (?)
glossary.ወርቅሰአ: ወርቅ — gold indeed (ወርቅ + emphatic -ሰ with a stray final -አ)
glossary.ወሰላም: ሰላም — and peace (ወ- + noun; the greeting formula ሰላም ለ- 'peace to')
glossary.ወሰዐሞ: ሰዐመ — and he kissed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him'; the part kissed is a second accusative)
glossary.ወቅናተ: ቅናት — and a belt, girdle (ወ- + noun, accusative; as ቅናታተ in ch. 13-16)
glossary.ወበሐዘነ: ሐዘን — and in the sorrow of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወበሰላምከመ: ሰላም — and in peace, that (ወ- + በ- + ሰላም, run together with ከመ 'that'; a missing wordspace)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበዝ: ዝ — and in this (ወ- + በ- + short demonstrative ዝ 'this')
glossary.ወቤተ: ቤት — and the house of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወብሔርየ: ብሔር — and my country (ወ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተሐፅን: ሐፀነ — and (she) nursed, carried in the lap (?) (ወ- + verb; the form is irregular, like ተሐምም) (?)
glossary.ወተመይጠ: ተመይጠ — and he turned (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of መይጠ)
glossary.ወተማሕፀንኩ: ተማሕፀነ — and I adjured, entreated (ወ- + 1cs perfect, tä-stem; 'entreat, swear by' + በ-)
glossary.ወተምህረት: ተመሀረ — and she was taught (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተቀበሎ: ተቀበለ — and he received him, went to meet him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ቀበለ + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወታቦተ: ታቦት — and the Ark (ወ- + noun, fem.; construct 'ark of')
glossary.ወትብሉኒ: ብህለ — and you say to me (ወ- + 2mp imperfect ትብሉ + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ወትኩን: ኮነ — and let it be, may it be (ወ- + 3fs jussive)
glossary.ወኀበ: ኀበ — and where (ወ- + ኀበ, place conjunction) · and to
glossary.ወኀበሀለወት: ሀለወ — and where she is (ወ- + ኀበ + 3fs perfect ሀለወት, run together; a missing wordspace)
glossary.ወነገረ: ነገር — and the affairs of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word, matter of'; the spelling is also that of a verb 'and he said') (?)
glossary.ወነግሀ: ነግህ — and morning (ወ- + noun, accusative as adverb)
glossary.ወነጽሮ: ነጸረ — and looking at (ወ- + verbal noun/gerund of ነጸረ 'look') (?)
glossary.ወንሕነኒ: ንሕነ — and we too (ወ- + 1cp pronoun + emphatic -ኒ)
glossary.ወንደለው: ደለወ — and we take our ease (?) (ወ- + 1cp subjunctive; the root is uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአልበሶ: አልበሰ — and he clothed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ለብሰ + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
glossary.ወአልባስ: ልብስ — and garment(s) (ወ- + noun, collective አልባስ)
glossary.ወአምላክናሁ: አምላክ — and ... God (?) (ወ- + አምላክ 'God' + ናሁ, which may be 'behold' or a stray suffix; a crux, perhaps corrupt for ወአምለከቶ 'and she worshipped him') (?)
glossary.ወአብኡ: አብአ — and they brought in (ወ- + 3mp perfect, A-stem of ቦአ 'enter')
glossary.ወአብኦ: አብአ — and he brought him in (ወ- + 3ms perfect, A-stem of ቦአ 'enter' + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንሰአ: አነ — and as for me (?) (ወ- + አነ 'I' + enclitic -ሰ; the final -አ is unexplained) · stray final -አ, as in ንሣእአ, ወሀበነአ, ወአንግሦአ (ch. 36), not a morpheme; again as ወአንሰዓ
glossary.ወአንሰዓ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- + አነ 'I' + emphatic -ሰ, with a stray final -ዓ like ወአንሰአ)
glossary.ወአንበሮ: አንበረ — and he set him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ነበረ 'sit, dwell' + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአንግሦአ: አንገሠ — and make him king! (ወ- + imperative አንግሥ + -ኦ 'him', with a stray final -አ; causative of ነግሠ 'reign')
glossary.ወአአምኅ: አምኀ — and (that) I pay homage (ወ- + 1cs subjunctive; 'greet, pay homage to') (?)
glossary.ወአክሊለ: አክሊል — and a crown (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወአዕይንቲሁ: ዐይን — and his eyes (ወ- + noun, plural አዕይንት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወአዝዝአ: አዘዘ — and command! (ወ- + 2ms imperative አዝዝ with a stray final -አ, or with an omitted object) (?)
glossary.ወአግብአቶሙ: አግብአ — and she brought them back (ወ- + 3fs perfect አግብአት + -ሙ 'them', causative of ገብአ 'return')
glossary.ወኢያውርድ: አውረደ — and lest he bring down (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive, causative of ወረደ 'descend')
glossary.ወኢይብሉ: ብህለ — and they do not say (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp imperfect)
glossary.ወኢይኤድሞ: አደመ — and it does not please him (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእመኒ: እመ — and if indeed, and whether (ወ- + እመ + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወእሠውዕ: ሠዋዐ — and I will sacrifice (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ወእሰግድ: ሰገደ — and I will bow (ወ- + 1cs imperfect)
glossary.ወእትጋነይ: ተጋነየ — and I will serve (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወእግነይ: ገነየ — and that I serve (ወ- + 1cs jussive, G)
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወወሊደኪ: ወሊድ — and your bearing, childbirth (ወ- + noun + -ኪ '2fs your')
glossary.ወወልድ: ወልድ — and the Son · and 'a son' in general (ወወልድ ለአብ 'and a son to the father')
glossary.ወወሰደ: ወሰደ — and he took away (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-s-d) · 'and he carried, brought' to someone (ወወሰደ ለአቡሁ ... ሕልቀተ 'and he brought to his father the ring')
glossary.ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወውእቱኒይልእክ: ውእቱ — and he too sends (ወ- + ውእቱ 'he' + emphatic -ኒ + ይልእክ 3ms imperfect of ለአከ; three words run together)
glossary.ወዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — and this one (ወ- + m. demonstrative)
glossary.ወዝንቱሰ: ዝንቱ — and this one indeed (ወ- + m. demonstrative + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይብልዎ: ብህለ — and they say to him (ወ- + 3mp imperfect ይብሉ + -ሎ '3ms to him', joined as ዎ)
glossary.ወይብሎ: ብህለ — and he says to him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect ይብል + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወፈትሐ: ፈትሐ — and he loosened, opened (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወፈንዎአ: ፈነወ — and send him! (ወ- + imperative ፈንዎ with -ኦ 'him' and a stray final -አ)
glossary.ወፍጽሞ: ፍጽም — and ... (?) (ወ- + ፍጽሞ, a word not identified; ፍጽም is 'perfect, whole', and ፍጽሞ may be an adverb or a body part; not rendered) (?)
glossary.ውሉድየ: ወልድ — my child, my offspring (plural/collective ውሉድ + -የ '1cs my'; used of one child)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ዘለአከተኒ: ለአከ — what she sent me (ዘ- 'what' + 3fs perfect ለአከት + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘበአማን: አማን — truly, in truth (ዘ- + በ- + noun; adverbial 'true, veritable')
glossary.ዘተሐምም: ተሐምመ — what she suffered (?) (ዘ- 'what' + a verb 'suffer, be afflicted'; the form is not the regular 3fs perfect ተሐምመት) (?)
glossary.ዘተናገርከ: ተናገረ — which you spoke (ዘ- + 2ms perfect, tä-stem 'converse, speak with')
glossary.ዘትሁቦሙ: ወሀበ — which you give them (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ዘትትሐመዩ: ተሐመየ — you who murmur, are troubled (?) (ዘ- + 2mp imperfect, tä-stem; the stem is uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘነውዎ: ዘነወ — who stood around him (?) (3mp perfect ዘነዉ + -ኦ 'him', joined as ዎ, agreeing with እለ; the ዘ- is a root letter, not the relative; the verb itself is not confirmed) (?)
glossary.ዘንተነገረ: ነገር — this matter (ዘንተ 'this' accusative + ነገረ 'word, matter', run together)
glossary.ዘኢየሐትቱ: ሐተተ — of whom they do not ask (ዘ- + ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G 'question, inquire')
glossary.ዘእምታሕተ: ታሕተ — who are under (ዘ- 'who' after ኵሉ + እም- + preposition ታሕተ 'beneath')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘወሀበኒ: ወሀበ — who gave me (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ዘወፅአ: ወፅአ — that which went out (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘየሀይድ: ሀየደ — which dazzles (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G; root and sense uncertain) · here 'which plunders/captivates the eyes' (ሀየደ 'plunder, carry off'; cf. አሀይድ in this part) (?) · in ch. 36 ዘየሀይድ አዕይንተ 'which dazzles the eyes' (ሀየደ taken as 'dazzle, blind') (?)
glossary.ዘይትዐረይ: ተዐረየ — which is matched, level (?) (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ዐረየ 'be equal'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘይከውን: ኮነ — who will be (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ዘፈረ: ዘፈር — fringe, hem of (noun, construct; sense guessed from context) (?)
glossary.ያመልኩ: አምለከ — they worship (3mp imperfect, causative, ʾ-m-l-k)
glossary.ያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — he loves (3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
glossary.ይልእክ: ለአከ — he sends, he sent (3ms imperfect, G; narrative habitual 'he would send')
glossary.ይሤኒ: ሠነየ — he is handsome, beautiful (3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትፈሣሕ: ተፈሥሐ — may he rejoice (3ms subjunctive, tä-stem of ፈሥሐ; subject ልብየ 'my heart')
glossary.ይኄይሰነ: ኀየሰ — it is better for us (3ms imperfect ይኄይስ + -ነ '1cp for us')
glossary.ይኄይሰኒ: ኀየሰ — it is better for me (3ms imperfect + -ኒ 'me')
glossary.ይኄይስ: ኀየሰ — he is better (3ms imperfect, G) · impersonal 'it is better' (ይኄይስ ዝየ ንብረት 'it is better to live here')
glossary.ይኩነነ: ኮነ — may he be for us (3ms jussive ይኩን + -ነ '1cp for us')
glossary.ዲባጋተ: ዲባግ — brocade, fine garment (noun, plural accusative; uncertain)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct)
glossary.ገጸከ: ገጽ — your face (noun + -ከ '2ms your', stem ገጸ- before the suffix)
glossary.ጣዖታተ: ጣዖት — idols (noun; plural ጣዖታት, accusative form)
glossary.ፈሪህየ: ፈሪህ — my fear (noun ፈሪህ, as ፈሪሀ in ch. 27, + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ፍጹመ: ፍጹም — perfectly, completely (adjective as adverbial accusative)
